flow.name: Hiding Night – Teil 3 (Finale) – Stimme Adam
flow.hinweis: Eigener Flow für das Finale. Ein Aufruf für den ganzen Text mit 2 Takes, keine Kostenschätzung vorab (Kosten = Zeichenzahl je Take).

eingabe.text:
Mister Hundred takes you at eighteen if it finds you, and it called to me in my sister's voice. Nobody can help you hide. If they try, it takes them too. My sister June hid me anyway, under her room.

[softly] "It never looks in my room, Rabbit."

Every night, she counts to one hundred before she falls asleep. She says it helps.

[nervous] Tonight, something above me finished her count, and asked if I was ready. I held my breath. It still came out white. Then the weight lifted off the boards. Through a crack, I saw June's red sneakers by her bed, side by side. Side by side is all it leaves. It took her, I thought, because she helped me. It left through her window.

Through the vent, I saw the bell tower, where Tess Lowry was hiding, higher than any window. It stood up straight, taller than anyone knew. Then it took its hands away from its face. Her flashlight went out. The bell rope swung once, without a sound.

Then it came down Main Street, looking in every upstairs window. It stopped at mine, then bent down to June's. I wanted to run, but Owen Pike ran, and only his shoes came home.

[nervous] The boards above me groaned. A long white finger slid through the crack and felt along the dirt, inches from my face. Then it pulled back. Nothing, until three in the morning.

[softly] "Rabbit?" "You can come out now." "It's gone."

It was June's voice, three hours before sunrise. I didn't answer. Then the voice started counting, like every night.

[softly] "Ninety-nine." "One hundred." "Ready, Rabbit?"

[nervous] I didn't answer. The hatch opened anyway. Mister Hundred folded itself into the crawl space, bent down, and took its hands away from its face. It had June's face, far too big. The eye I saw between its fingers was hers.

[softly] "It found me six years ago, Rabbit." "Dad hid me down here, so it took him, and kept me." "When I count, it sleeps." "I thought it would never look under its own bed."

Then the huge hands shook, and June pulled them back over her own face.

[softly] "Close your eyes, Rabbit." "Count with me."

She counted out loud, and it counted with her, slow and deep. I counted without a sound. Every time they reached one hundred, she started over, before it could ask. Near dawn, her voice grew faint, like she was falling asleep. At ninety-nine, she stopped. Instead of one hundred, the sunrise bell rang.

When I opened my eyes, Hiding Night was over, and I was alone. I climbed out. June's red sneakers still stood by her bed, side by side. In the hall, my sneakers still stood side by side.

Every night since, I count to one hundred before I fall asleep. It helps.

takes.befund: Satz 58 ist gesprochen, aber der Ganzdatei-Lauf von Whisper überspringt ihn (alle acht Wörter p = 0 bei 140,8 s); 'upstairs' hört er dort als 'video'. Einzeln ist beides richtig. Die Kette wurde für Take 2 nicht gerechnet

gruende: Wortzeiten: Im Ganzdatei-Lauf, aus dem timing.json entsteht, erkennt Whisper in Take 1 jedes Wort (vor der Kette 0,42 % Wortfehler, nach der Kette 0,21 %). In Take 2 überspringt er Satz 58 ganz (2,75 %); die Wortzeiten dort wären geschätzt, Untertitel und Schnitte der Schuh-Pointe säßen falsch
Junes Zeilen in Take 1 langsamer und zarter (Satzgrenzen der Bewertung): 'Close your eyes, Rabbit.' 1,34 s gegen 0,92 s, 'Count with me.' 1,04 s gegen 0,58 s (Spur ×1,2 vor dem Kürzen)

Lockruf in Take 1 klar höher als die Erzählung ('Ready, Rabbit?' 228 Hz, 'It's gone.' 204 Hz, Erzähler 147 Hz): Mit der Unterstimme im Mix bleibt June hörbar die Stimme von oben. In Take 2 misst die Bewertung 'One hundred' nur 0,18 s bei 122 Hz (dort legte Whisper aber auch ein zusätzliches 'one hundred' ein, die Grenze ist unsicher)
Hook 4,35 s (Ziel ≤ 4,5 s), Grundton 143 Hz wie Teil 1 (147 Hz) und Teil 2 (149 Hz); Spanne 11,4 Halbtöne gegen 9,6 in Take 2
Beide ohne Übersteuerung, Knackser oder gesprochene Tags. Linus' Ohr entscheidet zuletzt, Take 2 liegt unter build/folge-03/roh/
